verdicts.evidence: The heading scan's extra iteration reads lines[lines.length] === undefined; RegExp.test coerces it to the constant string 'undefined', which matches neither /^\s*(```|~~~)/ nor /^#{1,6}\s+Rule conformance/i, and `fenced` is reset before the loop over lines so its final state is dead. Sensitivity control: a divergence would require the coerced string to match one of the two regexes — impossible, it is the same constant for every input, with no hash and no fence; heads cannot receive this index. Measured: battery of 31 contents (including no final newline and a fence on the last line) byte-identical, 20 CLI missions identical, 7 legs of the net green.

verdicts.evidence: Unanchored, the fence regex toggles `fenced` on any line CONTAINING an inline ```. HONEST-REFUSAL recipe: green `init --example` mission + a prose line "Note: wrap format examples in ``` fences." before architecture.md's section → measured check --strict exit 0→1, 6 "not accounted for" violations (the real heading is skipped as fenced). ATTACK-ACCEPTANCE recipe: two real sections separated by a line with inline backticks — the shipped build refuses ("2 sections"), the mutant reads the FIRST, decoy section with zero problems (measured directly): the closed attack "example pasted above the real table" comes back to life. Double surface: the compliance pack silently goes from 36 to 30 counted rows (measured). Nothing sees it: the 7 legs replayed green — no gated deliverable of the repository, the example, the templates or the fixtures contains a triple backtick (grep = 0), and the unit fixtures only use balanced column-0 fences.

verdicts.evidence: CommonMark allows a fence indented by up to 3 spaces; the mutant stops following it. Recipe A: an illustration inside an indented fence ("␣␣```") whose fake example heading is in column 0 → measured exit 0→1 (refusal "2 Rule conformance sections" + 6 not-accounted) on an honest mission. Recipe B: fence opened in column 0, closed by "␣␣```" (GFM-legal) → the mutant no longer sees the closing, the whole rest of the document is "fenced": measured exit 0→1, 6 rules not accounted for. Battery and missions of the main sweep IDENTICAL precisely because the divergence only exists on indented fences — both recipes measured by a targeted probe. 7 legs green: every fence in the fixtures and the corpus is in column 0.

verdicts.evidence: Five survivors for four siblings KILLED in the same function (the fence toggle, its regex without `^`, the inner fence block, the inversion of `inFence`): so the probe is measurably sensitive here, on the same documents. What remains is on shapes that no markdown produced by this corpus takes — `i <= lines.length` on a loop already bounded by `break`, `/^#{1,6}\S/` where every heading carries a space, `/^\S*(```|~~~)/` where a closing fence is at the start of a line or indented. METHOD OF THIS PASS (identical for every verdict below, closed on 2026-09-18). The mutant is APPLIED to the build, a behaviour probe calls the product on inputs that reach the mutated line, and a canonical digest of 250+ observations is compared: pointer grammar over 34 cells, manifest sections over 12 documents (renamed heading, lowercase, deep, last, duplicated, inside a code block, unclosed block), decision journals over 16 layouts, nine real missions read by evidenceReport/evidenceBreakdown/collectSealableEvidence/requiresLedger/prosePointerLedger/computeVerdict in strict AND non-strict, and the exact bounds of the signature guard (30, 119, 120, 121, 511, 512, 513). COVERAGE VERIFIED: the 56 instructed survivors are all on a line the probe EXECUTES, measured by NODE_V8_COVERAGE taking the innermost range (the first version marked 1540 lines out of 1540 and measured nothing). SENSITIVITY PROVEN: on this same pass, 20 mutants moved the probe and are now KILLED by tests written after reading the difference — so the instrument does tell what changes from what does not. The probe was wrong six times before it was right, and its failure mode was always to answer "equivalent": branches not reached, messages cut at 200 characters, verdict truncated at 4000, wrong mutated occurrence chosen. Each correction surfaced changing mutants that would have been filed wrongly.
